name: Teamleader Focus
description: Teamleader Focus — the Belgian CRM, project and invoicing suite: companies, contacts, deals, projects, time tracking, invoices and quotations. REST API, OAuth 2.0, everything over POST.
instructions:
**Getting a token**
1. Register an integration in the **Teamleader Marketplace developer area** (developer.teamleader.eu). You receive a client id and client secret.
2. Run the authorization-code flow once for the account and keep the **refresh token** — Teamleader's access tokens last one hour.
3. Set `TEAMLEADER_CLIENT_ID`, `TEAMLEADER_CLIENT_SECRET` and `TEAMLEADER_REFRESH_TOKEN`. AnythingMCP refreshes the access token on its own.

**Every endpoint is a POST, including the reads.** Teamleader's API is action-shaped — `companies.list`, `deals.info`, `invoices.list` — and all of them are POSTs whose JSON body carries the filter. That is why these tools look like writes in an HTTP trace even when they only read; the tool names here say what each one actually does.

**Filters are a nested object.** `{"filter": {"term": "Acme"}, "page": {"size": 20, "number": 1}, "sort": [{"field": "name", "order": "asc"}]}`. The available filter keys differ per action and are listed in Teamleader's reference.

**Refresh tokens rotate.** Teamleader issues a new refresh token on every refresh and invalidates the old one. AnythingMCP persists the rotated token back into the connector, so the stored value stays current — but if you also use the same refresh token from another script, one of the two will start failing.

**Ids are UUIDs**, and `deals.info` needs the deal's id, not its reference number.

**Cloud reachability**: api.focus.teamleader.eu is public with a valid certificate.

tools.name: teamleader_get_me
tools.description: Read the user the token belongs to, with their name, e-mail, language and account. The fastest proof that the OAuth client and refresh token work.

tools.name: teamleader_list_companies
tools.description: List client companies with their name, VAT number, address and tags. A POST that only reads — that is how Teamleader's API is shaped.

term.description: Search fragment matched against name, VAT number and e-mail.

tools.name: teamleader_get_company
tools.description: Read one company in full: addresses, VAT number, payment terms, custom fields, tags and the account manager.

tools.name: teamleader_list_contacts
tools.description: List individual contacts with their name, e-mail, phone and the companies they are linked to.

term.description: Search fragment matched against name, e-mail and phone.

tools.name: teamleader_list_deals
tools.description: List deals with their title, customer, value, phase and expected closing date — the sales-pipeline view.

term.description: Search fragment matched against the deal title and reference.

phase_id.description: Restrict to one pipeline phase UUID.

status.description: Statuses to include: open, won, lost.

tools.name: teamleader_get_deal
tools.description: Read one deal in full: its value, phase, source, responsible user, linked quotations and the full phase history.

id.description: Deal UUID — not the reference number.

tools.name: teamleader_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices with their number, date, due date, customer, totals and payment status — the receivables view.

status.description: Statuses to include: draft, outstanding, matched.

tools.name: teamleader_list_projects
tools.description: List projects with their title, customer, status, budget and the milestones they are broken into.

tools.name: teamleader_list_time_tracking
tools.description: List tracked time entries with their user, date, duration, project and invoiceability — the raw data behind 'how much did we spend on this client'.

started_after.description: Earliest start, ISO 8601 with a zone.

started_before.description: Latest start, ISO 8601 with a zone.

tools.name: teamleader_list_quotations
tools.description: List quotations with their deal, total, status and validity date, to see what is out with prospects and not yet accepted.
